stop_reason: First delivered image satisfies every frozen gate; no repair or second generation.

supplemental_artistic_review.unlabeled_impression: A quiet, inviting encounter on a wet bridge before departure, with a close companion presence and a distinct magical destination.
supplemental_artistic_review.hierarchy: Face and eye line lead; red-gold tie and hand-held shaft anchor the body; white owl, claws and pale letter read next; the large castle gives the journey a destination.
strengths: The supplied face and bob remain strongly recognizable at the delivered scale.
Rain reflections, coarse broom binding, white feathers and knitted layers share coherent lighting and material texture.
The owl/letter junction is unusually clear and the castle reads through the same spatial field.
weaknesses: The frame is a conversational mid-body environmental portrait, so exact boots-on-paving support and the full broom length are not shown.
The castle is large and competes somewhat with the face rather than staying a small destination.
supplemental_artistic_review.control_comparison: Only after the unlabeled impression was described, it was compared with the frozen controls: relaxed eyes and parted lips supply a supporting attraction consistent with sensual=1; the image introduces no new surreal relation beyond the fantasy travel context. Perceived appeal is an agent observation and user preference remains pending.
